measurements.name: mesh_validator_findings
measurements.observed: godot_validate_meshes checked 137 meshes/137 surfaces and returned 44 degenerate_uvs findings, including cemetery package and Bellkeeper/Warden presentation meshes (up to 45% of triangles).

details.observed: The runtime mesh validator reports candidate-visible degenerate UV surfaces that can silently corrupt tangents and produce dark or malformed shading; no editor/runtime log error explains these render defects.
reproduction: Run the candidate to gameplay.
Invoke godot_validate_meshes on the running scene with include_hidden=false.
Inspect the reported visible authored mesh surfaces.
retest_recipe: Repair or bind valid planar UV/tangent data for every affected visible surface while preserving intact authored packages.
Re-run godot_validate_meshes and recapture the same gameplay camera frames.
Confirm no dark/corrupted surfaces remain.

blocking_focus: Camera coverage remains partially occluded and player/threat silhouettes are too small in shipped framing.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Deliver one closure-ready authored-world presentation pass that restores readable cemetery traversal and camera framing, makes runtime-visible mesh shading safe, and completes combat feedback, animation/VFX/lighting/audio, first-run guidance, HUD choice hierarchy, accessibility, and restart/result shell behavior.

diagnosis.root_cause: The prior camera changes did not resolve the shipped composition because active scene presentation and occluder bindings still leave the Warden and threats distant or hidden. Runtime-visible authored surfaces still report degenerate UVs, indicating the integration-bound mesh/material path is not yet authoritative for validation. The HUD choice surface also needs an explicit authored visual hierarchy rather than text-stacked cards.

stop_conditions: Author exactly one task covering every required gap exactly once.
Assign each active issue id exactly once; Tester and GameLoop Runtime retain recapture and closure authority.

Preserve the intact AuthoredCemeteryPackage, Warden authored presentation, guidance illustration, and custom upgrade-card icon hierarchy; do not replace them without explicit package-level incompatibility.
Do not preselect a named asset, reference project, or template; Developer performs bounded inspection and validation.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different integration strategy from repeated transform tuning: preserve the authored map and Warden, repair active camera/presentation and occluder bindings, make a validated integration-bound UV/tangent path authoritative or explicitly render-safe, and complete the missing player-facing world, feedback, guidance, HUD, accessibility, and lifecycle behavior in one retestable pass.

code: Run native_godot_project and host_godot_boot smoke checks after edits; confirm no parse/runtime errors in touched scenes and scripts.

Run focused checks for authoritative camera and occluder NodePaths, authored-map collision/boundary anchors, runtime UV/tangent binding receipts, combat event ownership, InputMap-derived guidance, UI choice hierarchy/focus predicates, and restart teardown.
Verify preserved package/Warden/guidance/icon hierarchies remain intact and no proxy geometry or destructive asset edits were introduced.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime recaptures failed camera and mesh evidence plus sparse spawn, critical-route, landmark/cardinal, dense-wave, guidance, upgrade, pause, result, and retry states using registered movement, spatial, mesh, page-state, and runtime-state probes.

Tester repeats the same ordinary movement/movement replay and dash route to verify player/threat readability, central building and landmark visibility, collision, disappearance/occlusion behavior, external world depth, and perimeter boundary.

Tester validates automatic targeting and reward/upgrade transactions, animation/VFX/lighting/audio cues, first-run guidance dismissal and controls/help discovery, silhouette/icon-led weapon and upgrade choices with truthful current-to-new deltas, keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus, settings, pause, death, victory, result, and clean retry; unresolved defects remain in the ledger.
visual: Capture shipped gameplay at acceptance width with player, Warden, threats, authored streets, central building/landmarks, external world depth, escape lane, and compact HUD; include traversal, dense combat, guidance, and upgrade-choice frames.

Inspect runtime views for UV-induced dark/corrupted shading, silhouette scale/occlusion, collision-ground alignment, combat impact clarity, animation state changes, warm-versus-cool lighting hierarchy, and audio/VFX legibility; reject placeholders, proxy floors, matte contamination, and fixed-corner or text-stacked UI.

done_when: The shipped high-angle camera keeps the full player, nearby threats, pickups, and an escape lane readable; the Warden and dangerous telegraphs are not materially occluded during ordinary movement or objective traversal.

The authored cemetery remains the sole authoritative visual environment and expands to a larger traversable scale with coherent external world depth; the central building and each landmark remain stable and visible, with collision matching visible geometry, no disappearance or occlusion drift, and a clear boundary/perimeter during ordinary movement and movement replay.

Runtime-visible authored meshes pass visible UV/tangent validation with no degenerate surfaces in the authoritative binding, or affected surfaces are explicitly isolated from moonlit shading with no dark/corrupted result; the imported authored package remains untouched and no proxy floor replaces authored streets.

First-run guidance briefly teaches movement, dash, automatic attacks, pickup collection, and the first upgrade in the real arena using the bound authored illustration, live InputMap glyphs, dismissal, and a discoverable controls/help surface without consuming combat input or reappearing on retry.

Automatic combat remains causally attributable: each weapon identity, targeting, hit, enemy reaction/death, drop, collection, level-up, boss warning/phase, victory, and failure has distinct bounded visual/audio feedback without duplicate or placeholder effects.

Player/enemy idle, locomotion, attack/cast, hurt, death, dash, and victory states are readable from actual planar motion; moonlit blue-violet fill, warm lantern light, hostile accents, restrained fog/shadows, and music/audio transitions remain legible at dense-wave pressure.
Gameplay HUD leaves the arena readable while showing health, experience/level, wave/run progress, equipped weapons/ranks, dash readiness, contextual boss health, and compact enemy vitality feedback.

Weapon and upgrade choices replace text-stacked cards with recognizable silhouettes or authored icons first, compact stat icons, truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, restrained names/consequence copy, and distinct keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/hover/selected/unavailable states without placeholder CURRENT values or unchanged rows; pause, result,.
tasks.instructions: Inspect the existing authored cemetery scene, ArenaCamera bindings, runtime mesh/material assignments, Warden presentation, combat/effect hooks, first-run guidance, and HUD shell. Preserve the intact authored package and Warden hierarchy. Repair camera_framing_readability at the integration level by correcting active scene bindings, occluder pairing/fade or sight-lane handling, and shipped composition so player/threat silhouettes remain readable; do not merely repeat a camera transform tweak. Repair visible_mesh_degenerate_uvs by tracing which runtime mesh resources validator and renderer actually use, then making valid UV/tangent integration copies authoritative or isolating affected surfaces from moonlit shading; never perform destructive source surgery. Keep authored streets/terrain as the map, adding only outer datum plus collision, navigation, spawn, and objective anchors when required. Implement the missing authored-world increment across automatic combat causality, movement/dash and enemy animation, VFX, lighting/audio timing, first-run guidance, HUD/product shell, and restart/result lifecycle. For upgrade and weapon choices, explicitly replace text-stacked presentations with silhouette/icon-led hierarchy, compact stat icons, truthful current-to-new values limited to three decision-relevant deltas, omission of unchanged/placeholder fields, restrained copy, and complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states. Add only candidate-owned instrumentation that enables direct same-loop black-box and white-box retest; telemetry alone is insufficient. Do not name or preselect replacement assets or references.
tasks.title: Repair authored cemetery presentation, camera readability, and runtime mesh integrity
